PHI401 - Ezk.
The sir teaches very well and provides highly engaging lectures, so you won't feel bored. Make sure to take class lecture notes in your notebook. At the end of each chapter, he discusses a few case studies. Listen attentively as questions for the midterms and finals come from these discussions.
Now, about the quizzes: There are 2 quizzes, and both will count. The quizzes are MCQ-based. Reading the slides thoroughly is enough, but you also need to follow the class lectures.
For the midterms and finals, there are four types of questions:
Knowledge-based questions: You’ll need to write definitions. Out of 3, you’ll answer any 2.
Comprehension-based questions: These are like short questions. You just need to present the points accurately. Out of 3, answer any 2.
Application-based questions: A famous philosopher's quote will be given, and you’ll need to explain logically whether the statement is correct or not. Out of 3, answer any 2.
Higher-order thinking questions: For these, he’ll discuss many case studies in class. Questions will require you to relate the topic to the case studies. If you can write this well, you’ll get good marks. Out of 3, answer any 2.
The sir gives good marks. There will be a viva, and you need to take it seriously. Grades won’t be curved; you’ll get what you deserve.
